explanation: It is about 0 everywhere except at D1 right after a trial where the agent chose a2, got the rare transition to S1, and was rewarded; there it is usually 8-10 (lower, around 6, early in the episode), even when this happens several trials in a row. It stays 0 at every GO and D2 step, after an unrewarded rare a2-to-S1 trial, after any common trial, and after a1 trials, including a1 trials that reached S2 rarely and were rewarded.
